SYSML_BATTERY_MANAGEMENT_SYSTEM.content: The controller that keeps the traction battery inside its safe operating window, reports its state and keeps it at a usable temperature.
SYSML_BATTERY_MANAGEMENT_SYSTEM.title: Battery Management System

SYSML_CELL_BALANCING.content: Brings the cell voltages of the pack back together after a charge session.
SYSML_CELL_BALANCING.title: Cell Balancing

SYSML_CELL_PROTECTION.content: Keeps every cell inside the safe window of its chemistry: measures voltage, temperature and current, and opens the high-voltage contactors when a limit is violated.
SYSML_CELL_PROTECTION.title: Cell Protection

SYSML_ISOLATION_MONITORING.content: Watches the insulation between the high-voltage bus and the vehicle chassis.
SYSML_ISOLATION_MONITORING.title: Isolation Monitoring

SYSML_STATE_ESTIMATION.content: Estimates the state of charge and the remaining capacity, and says when that estimate can no longer be trusted.
SYSML_STATE_ESTIMATION.title: State Estimation

SYSML_THERMAL_MANAGEMENT.content: Keeps the pack at a usable temperature and derates the permitted discharge power when it runs hot.
SYSML_THERMAL_MANAGEMENT.title: Thermal Management
